prompt: Build me a comprehensive personal finance dashboard with multiple interactive visualizations. I need: 1) An expense tracker with category-based filtering and monthly/yearly views, 2) A budget vs actual spending comparison with progress bars, 3) An investment portfolio section showing allocation pie charts and performance graphs, 4) A financial goals tracker with progress indicators, and 5) A dark/light theme toggle. Use modern React patterns, proper state management, and make it mobile-responsive. The data should be realistic and the UI should feel polished - no generic templates please.
